name: Gordon
title: Gordon — Trading Agent
description: AI trading agent for crypto and equities. Connects to crypto exchanges via CCXT (Binance, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, Hyperliquid, and 90+ more) plus equity brokers. Read-only onchain data and wallet-intelligence adapters for DEX pools, yields, and address labels. Built-in risk classifier, trade ledger, and the Gordon safety stack. Runs proactive radar for news/regime/volatility/funding signals.

auth.description: Set provider keys in env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, or DEDALUS_API_KEY. Optional exchange credentials (BINANCE_API_KEY etc.) for live trading.
